summary: Nova Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that it will host an Investor Day on March 9, 2027, at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York City; the release is a scheduling notice rather than a transaction. Presentations will come from President and CEO Gaby Waisman, CFO Guy Kizner and CTO Shay Wolfling, followed by a Q&A, with event timing to be announced later and RSVPs handled via the company's investor-day page. No terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or regulatory clock are stated; the only filings-adjacent items are the signature of CFO Guy Kizner and IR contact details. This is a routine investor-relations calendar event with no structural or risk-arb angle; watch the March 9, 2027 disclosures for any strategic or guidance updates.
